title: components.json
description: Configuration for a project using zard/ui. Written by `zard-cli init` and read by every other command.

$schema.description: This file's schema. Keeping it lets your editor validate and complete the fields below.

style.description: The look the components are installed with. `css` is what projects initialized before styles existed carry and is read as the current look (nova); the eight names are written by `zard-cli init --preset` and `zard-cli apply`, which install the matching spacing, radius and typography.

icons.description: The icon set the components are written against. Every component draws through ng-icons, which stays the dependency either way; this picks which of its packages comes along. The valid values are the ones the registry publishes in icons.json — lucide, tabler, hugeicons, phosphor and remixicon today — and the CLI lists them if you write something it does not know. An icon a set has no equivalent for is reported when you add the component and keeps its lucide import.

rtl.description: Whether the project reads right to left. The components are direction-agnostic (logical classes and the CDK Directionality), so the files the CLI installs are identical either way. `zard-cli init --rtl` records true here and sets dir="rtl" on <html> in the app's index.html.

projectType.description: The kind of project. Decides which tsconfig holds the paths, whether Tailwind goes through PostCSS or a Vite plugin, and whether there is an application to register providers in.

appConfigFile.description: The file that holds the application providers, where provideZard() is registered. Empty in a library, which has no application config.

packageManager.description: The package manager used to install dependencies.

menuColor.description: Whether menus, popovers and dropdowns take the inverted palette (dark in light mode, light in dark mode). Written by `zard-cli init --preset` and `zard-cli apply`.

menuAppearance.description: Whether menus and popovers are opaque or translucent with a backdrop blur. A translucent menu always uses the subtle accent.

menuAccent.description: How the focused or hovered menu item is painted: a neutral wash (subtle) or the primary color (bold).

preset.description: The preset code the project was last fully configured from, as built on https://zardui.com/create. Informational: it records the design, nothing reads it to decide what to install.

registryUrl.description: A registry other than the official one, for teams publishing their own component set. Must be HTTPS, or localhost during development.

css.description: The global stylesheet the init command writes the theme tokens into.

baseColor.description: The base colour of the generated theme.

baseUrl.description: The root the aliases below resolve from — the directory that holds the application code.

aliases.description: The import paths components are written with. The CLI maps them in your tsconfig.
